rationale: Focused validation library of 79 candidate genes from the genome-wide PigGeCKO screen (about 1,400 guides, 15 ntc non-targeting controls) in PK-15-Cas9 cells challenged with TGEV at high MOI for up to five rounds (Sun et al. 2021). GEO deposits only read1/read2 normalized values (two decimals); prepare.R recovers the integer reads (each column is raw reads times one constant; 100% of values become integers), copied into recovery_scales.json, then sums the two reads of each library. Gene symbols are mapped from the companion PigGeCKO file by Ensembl id. Rounds 3 and 5 are sequential selections of one population, each compared with the control library (1 vs 1, no-replicate path, screening-level). Enrichment is read first (resistance genes expand); totals are median-ratio size factors because a few guides dominate the selected libraries.
